Title: Anil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Anil - 33 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Hema - 58 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Suresh - 67 years, king, father
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
4. Vinod - 44 years, general
Look: iron armour, red turban
5. Anjali - 28 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress

Places

1. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust

Scene 1: The battlefield - Day

[Anil stands on the battlefield. Hema, Suresh and Vinod stand near him.]

Anil: "Vinod, what's the plan today?"

[A sword slashes Anil's arm and blood runs down to his wrist.]

Hema: "Vinod, look at this."

[Struck by the arrow, Anil falls and dies.]

Suresh: "No… this cannot be!"
